description: Content Item = three groups. Product expression of a Canonical Technique when identity.technique_id is set (accepted rows only). Canon: docs/practices/PRACTICE_CONTENT_TAXONOMY_V1.md §10. Provenance: docs/practices/PRACTICE_TECHNIQUE_PROVENANCE_V1.md. Fill policy: docs/practices/PRACTICE_LIBRARY_FILL_V1.md.

fields.item_id: stable id; never emitted by Meaning
fields.seed_cell: P0 seed-pass only: the one need cell this item was created for. Retrieval tags do not close other cells.
fields.technique_id: optional; only if technique_canon status=accepted; Meaning never emits it

fields.locales: { lang: { title, body } }; ru required for P0
fields.presentation: surface labels only; not a second retrieval index

invariants: Meaning never stores item_id or technique_id
purpose must not be encoded in type
family is required iff content_class is practice
technique_id if set must exist in technique_canon_v1
item is a product expression of a canonical technique, not the source of the technique
